## Checklist

- [ ] `node tests/run.mjs` passes
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that **fails without the fix**
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
- [ ] If a colour changed, the palette validator was re-run in **both** light and dark
- [ ] Comments explain *why*, not *what*
- [ ] None of the [non-negotiables](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-non-negotiables) is weakened
